lineMove.line.kindsMade: Created the line kinds {kinds} in the project (from the as of pointsAt and the keys of payloads)
lineMove.line.landingOutside: The landing "{at}" of the {kind} line is outside the partner and has no card there, so it cannot be a line and was copied to the end of the description
lineMove.line.landingOutsideFrom: The landing "{at}" of the {kind} line from {from} is outside the partner and has no card there, so it cannot be a line and was copied to the end of the description
lineMove.line.pathWithoutPlace: {key} "{path}" has no place to land, so it cannot be a line and was copied to the end of the description
lineMove.line.payloadKeyWithoutPlace: The key {keys} of payload "{payload}" has no place to land, so it cannot be a line and was copied to the end of the description
lineMove.line.payloadWithoutKey: payload "{payload}" has no key, so it cannot be a line and was copied to the end of the description
lineMove.line.pointerWithoutTarget: {path}: pointsAt (as: {word}) has neither a partner nor a discriminator, so it cannot be a line
lineMove.line.refWithoutTarget: {path}: type ref has no partner, so the type was set back to string
lineMove.line.split: Split {count} of the {what} into two lines each: one to the partner and one "link" to where the values are ({cards})
lineMove.part.splitLandings: lines whose landing was outside the partner
lineMove.part.splitPointers: pointsAt lines whose in was in a card other than the partner
